title: Yoisaki Kanade — Profile Story

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<What...?
You want us to do our self-intros for N25 again? Like we did before?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<But why now all of a sudden?
I thought we decided not to show them last time since they gave off such different impressions compared to our songs...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <You had fun introducing yourself to your new class, so we might enjoy doing something similar...?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I see...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, I agree.
It might be fun to do something like this for a change.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<But what do I talk about.
I suppose I should start with my name...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... I'm mainly the composer for Nightcord at 25:00. My name is Kanade Yoisaki—Oh, my handle is K...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<What else is there...? Oh, right.
I was also the one who started this group.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I've been composing songs since I was little.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But something happened to make me feel I need to compose as many songs as I can... In the hopes that they'll make somebody happy.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <While I did that, I learned about the others and decided to reach out to them. That was how I ended up forming our group.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <We met each other, made music and ended up going through quite a lot together...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <As we got to know each other, there were some growing pains, but that also gave me a chance to see things from very different perspectives...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I doubt I would've ever arrived on the kind of music I make now on my own.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <N25 exists as it currently does because of the others. I owe them so much.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, um... What I'm trying to say is...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I hope we get to keep making music together.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<*Sigh*
That should be enough...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Huh?
It stopped being a self-intro partway through?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Oh, you're right.
That last part was sort of meant for all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Still, you're the ones who are listening right now, Yuki, so I'm glad I got a chance to say what I just did.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Anyway...
I'm looking forward to doing more together.>
